methodology.transcript_scope: full transcript; not limited to overlapping speech
methodology.context_policy: Each response turn is assessed against up to 3 immediately preceding chronological turns; target may be any different speaker in that window.
methodology.moderator_policy: Moderation, introductions, summaries, follow-up questions, and repetition without a stance are uncertain; substantive stances are classified normally. Host identity is not used for classification.
methodology.overlap_policy: Overlap and interruption are not evidence of stance by themselves.
methodology.uncertain_policy: Every eligible response turn receives one record; unclear or non-stance turns are classified uncertain.
methodology.target_policy: Target is a specific earlier turn; no reverse inference. Response timestamp determines subtopic mapping.
limitations: ASR errors can affect stance and exact quote matching.
The analysis does not infer intent, ideology, bias, or factual correctness.
